description: Reskin all WorkspaceHub tabs and auth pages. Depends on FEAT-001 (tokens) and FEAT-002 (new components). WorkspaceHub.jsx visual overhaul: integrate IntelligenceCore, AgentCard, ImpactFileList, PipelineStatus, StatCard into the appropriate tabs. Replace hardcoded color values (#1F2937, #818CF8, rgba(79,70,229,...), etc.) with CSS token vars. Reskin Login, Register, ForgotPassword to centered single-column dark forms. Run build and fix ALL errors.
steps: Step 1 — Reskin WorkspaceHub.jsx header banner. Replace the .hero-panel div (which uses the old gradient background) with a flat header bar: background var(--surface), border-bottom 1px solid var(--border), padding 16px 24px. Remove the animated border-color classes. Replace the stat-chip sync indicator colors: syncing→var(--warning), live→var(--nvidia). Replace repo <select> styles: background var(--surface-2), border var(--border), color var(--text), border-radius var(--radius). Replace inline hardcoded grays (#1F2937→var(--surface-2), #0b1329→var(--bg), rgba(15,23,42,*)→var(--surface), rgba(255,255,255,0.08)→var(--border), #94A3B8→var(--text-2), #E2E8F0→var(--text), #FFFFFF→var(--text), #CBD5E1→var(--text-2)). Replace .primary-btn active color from gradient indigo to var(--nvidia) background with #000 text. Replace .secondary-btn to use var(--surface-2) background var(--border) border.

Step 2 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 1 (overview). Replace MetricCard color props: first card '#22C55E'→var(--nvidia) string literal, second '#4F46E5'→var(--info), third '#F59E0B'→var(--warning), fourth '#38BDF8'→var(--info). Replace AIStatus panel wrapper styles. Replace history table header/row border colors. Replace preset button active state '#4F46E5'→var(--nvidia). Add IntelligenceCore between the requirement snapshot card and file indexer card (import IntelligenceCore from '../components/IntelligenceCore'). Replace navigate buttons colors.

Step 3 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 2 (files). Replace filter button active background '#4F46E5'→var(--nvidia). Replace search input wrapper border. Replace file table module badge and action button colors. Replace code viewer panel background '#0b1329'→var(--bg) and pre color '#C7D2FE'→var(--text-2). Replace status banner colors. Replace modal overlay background.

Step 4 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 3 (requirement). Replace preset button active '#4F46E5'→var(--nvidia). Replace Story ID input styles to use var(--surface-2)/var(--border). Replace doc upload drag zone active border color. Replace textarea background '#1F2937'→var(--surface-2) border rgba(255,255,255,0.1)→var(--border). Replace Analyze button gradient→background var(--nvidia) color #000. Add a small context card showing: NVIDIA NIM chip (import NvidiaStatus) so users see the AI provider before running analysis.

Step 5 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 4 (impact). Import ImpactFileList from '../components/ImpactFileList'. Replace <ImpactTable files={analysisData?.impactedFiles} /> with <ImpactFileList files={analysisData?.impactedFiles} />. Replace the 4 stat mini-cards inline styles: #22C55E→var(--nvidia), #4F46E5→var(--info), #F59E0B→var(--warning). Replace advisory primer card border color. Replace DependencyGraph wrapper card styles.

Step 6 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 5 (review). Replace ReviewCard color props: qualityScore '#22C55E'→var(--nvidia), regressionRisk '#F59E0B'→var(--warning), testGaps '#818CF8'→var(--info), securityClearance '#22C55E'→var(--nvidia). Replace git diff textarea: background var(--bg), color var(--nvidia) (green diff text), border var(--border), font-family var(--font-mono). Replace Run Pre-Review button. Replace review report card border-color with var(--nvidia) at 30% opacity. Replace Loader wrapper styles.

Step 7 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 6 (pr). Import PipelineStatus from '../components/PipelineStatus'. Add <PipelineStatus /> above the PR title card. Replace readonly input/textarea: background var(--surface-2), border var(--border), font-family var(--font-mono). Replace Copy/Export/Publish button styles. Publish button background: var(--nvidia) color #000.

Step 8 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 7 (agents). Import AgentCard from '../components/AgentCard'. Import IntelligenceCore from '../components/IntelligenceCore'. Layout: left column gets IntelligenceCore at top, then 5 AgentCard instances (one per AGENTS_LIST entry). Map AGENTS_LIST to AgentCard props: name=agent.name, state=workflow[agentKey] where agentKey maps coord→coordinator, req→requirement, impact→impact, review→review, pr→pr; description=agent.role, model=agent.model, isActive=workflow[key]==='Running'. Remove the old inline agent card divs. Keep the right column AIStatus panel.

Step 9 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 8 (analytics). Replace hotspot card hardcoded background '#1F2937'→var(--surface-2), border colors. Replace metric bar colors: #38BDF8→var(--info), #818CF8→var(--info), #22C55E→var(--nvidia), #F59E0B→var(--warning).

Step 10 — Reskin WorkspaceHub TAB 9 (settings). Add an NVIDIA NIM panel card (after the AI config card, before integrations) showing: NvidiaStatus component + model string + status 'Connected'. Do NOT show any API key. The model display comes from import.meta.env.VITE_NVIDIA_MODEL or fallback. Replace form input/select/label styles using CSS token vars.

Step 11 — Reskin WorkspaceHub modals (Add File Modal, Batch Modal). Replace modal overlay rgba(2,6,23,0.75)→rgba(0,0,0,0.8). Replace modal card styles. Replace input/select styles in modals. Replace Save/Cancel button styles.

Step 12 — Reskin frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx. REMOVE the two-column layout entirely. Replace with a single centered column (max-width:440px, margin:auto). Top: ImpactIQ logotype in monospace (same as Topbar — 'Impact' + 'IQ' in --nvidia). Subtitle: 'Powered by NVIDIA NIM' in --text-3 12px. Form card: background var(--surface), border 1px solid var(--border), border-radius var(--radius-lg), padding 32px. Email/password inputs: background var(--bg), border var(--border), border-radius var(--radius), color var(--text). Submit button: background var(--nvidia), color #000, border-radius var(--radius), padding 12px, font-weight:700. Error banner: background rgba(204,51,51,0.12), border var(--error) at 40%, color var(--error). Forgot password link: color var(--nvidia). Register link: color var(--nvidia). Remove ALL left panel markup, feature highlight grid, metrics strip, shimmer-text class, animated-border class, gradient box-shadow references. Keep all form logic (handleSubmit, email/password state, showPassword toggle, useAuth hook usage) completely intact.

Step 13 — Reskin frontend/src/pages/Register.jsx. Same approach as Login: single column max-width:440px centered card. ImpactIQ logo + 'Powered by NVIDIA NIM'. Step 1 form (name/email/password/role): graphite card, green CTA. Step 2 OTP: same card, 6 OTP digit inputs reskinned (background var(--bg), border var(--border-2), color var(--text), focused border var(--nvidia)). Keep ALL multi-step logic (requestOtp, verifyAndCreateAccount, otpInputRefs, countdown timer, resend) untouched. Remove any decorative purple/indigo gradient elements.

Step 14 — Reskin frontend/src/pages/ForgotPassword.jsx. Single centered column, same card style. Three steps: request email → OTP verify → success. Keep ALL step logic (sendForgotPasswordOtp, resetPasswordWithOtp, otpInputRefs, countdown, step state). Replace button/input/link colors with graphite+green tokens.

Step 15 — Run npm run build. Fix ALL compilation errors before marking this FEAT complete. Common failure patterns to watch for: (a) import of NvidiaStatus/IntelligenceCore/AgentCard/ImpactFileList/PipelineStatus/StatCard with wrong relative path — verify against actual file locations. (b) Topbar import in WorkspaceHub: '../components/Topbar' must exist. (c) Any JSX syntax error from inline style edits. (d) Missing closing tags. Re-run build after each fix until exit code 0.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits with code 0 and zero errors
Login.jsx is single-column with no left panel or shimmer-text class
WorkspaceHub agents tab renders 5 AgentCard components and IntelligenceCore
WorkspaceHub impact tab renders ImpactFileList (not ImpactTable) for the file registry
WorkspaceHub pr tab renders PipelineStatus above the PR title card
WorkspaceHub settings tab shows NVIDIA NIM panel with no API key visible
No hardcoded #6366f1, #818CF8, #8b5cf6, #ec4899, #06b6d4 color values remain in WorkspaceHub.jsx or auth pages (replaced with CSS var tokens)
